user.title: Connect to Hup
user.description: Enter your Hup webhook URL and API key. You can add devices to monitor after setup.

data_description.webhook_url: The webhook URL generated in the Hup app for receiving events.
data_description.api_key: Your external device API key from the Hup app (starts with hup_ext_).
data_description.device_id: The device ID for this Home Assistant instance in Hup.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Check your key in the Hup app under Settings.
error.invalid_key_format: API key must start with hup_ext_.

init.title: Monitored Entities
init.description: Select the entities to send events to Hup for. You can change this at any time.

data_description.entities: Select cameras, sensors, lights, switches, or any other entities to monitor.
